C0297.title: RECUR Attack: Resource Exhaustion via Recursive Entropy-Guided Counterfactual Exploitation and Reflection
C0297.summary: Researchers propose the RECUR attack method, which induces excessive reflection in large reasoning models (LRMs) by constructing counterfactual problems, leading to an 11× increase in output length and a 90% drop in throughput, thereby consuming computational resources. This attack reveals inherent resource exhaustion vulnerabilities within the reasoning process itself.
